about.title: About CWAG
about.description: The Coaches' Welfare Association of Gujarat (CWAG) represents the interests and welfare concerns of sports coaches in Gujarat. The association provides a collective platform for representing coaches' concerns and engaging with relevant authorities on matters affecting their professional welfare.

verified.title: Documented Activity
verified.text: In August 2024, CWAG submitted a written representation to the Director General of the Sports Authority of Gujarat, raising concerns about coaches' promotions, seniority, pension-account allocation, and group-insurance benefits.

focusAreas.title: Areas of Focus
items: Representing the collective interests of sports coaches in Gujarat
Advocating for fair promotions and recognition of seniority
Raising issues concerning pension and insurance benefits
Representing coaches' service-related concerns before relevant authorities
Supporting the professional welfare and interests of coaches
focusAreas.disclaimer: These focus areas are indicated by publicly documented activities. Official objectives should be confirmed with the association.

mission.title: Our Focus
mission.text: To provide a collective platform for representing the interests, welfare, and service-related concerns of sports coaches in Gujarat.

vision.title: Our Aim
vision.text: A Gujarat where sports coaches receive fair recognition, timely promotions, and comprehensive welfare benefits.

verified.title: CWAG Raises Coaches' Concerns with SAG
verified.summary: The Coaches' Welfare Association of Gujarat submitted a written representation to the Director General of the Sports Authority of Gujarat, raising concerns about 113 coaches' delayed promotions, pending pension-account allocation, and group-insurance benefits.
